validated_findings: Frozen PPO packaging and research/release trajectory parity passed recorded audits.
Frozen PPO won all 15 recoverable historical loss replay traces in open-loop replay mode; this does not prove superiority against adaptive source agents.
Low and high current PPO MCV groups have similar workers, plants, pastures, and 3-land outcomes.
Current covered sell-value gap high-minus-low is approximately milk +63170, strawberry +50772, wool +3451.
Current low/high milk realized sell prices average approximately 51 versus 175.
Prior phases validate endogenous shared-market price pressure and favorable market-regime effects.
Generic milk holding, broad market preservation, early land expansion, second crop cycles, and solo-only screening were rejected or neutral under stronger gates.
rejected_or_do_not_repeat: generic milk holding and late milk timing as a blanket fix
Land #4 implementation as the next change
unilateral market preservation and broad batch capping
solo GPU screens without paired shared-market validation
retraining or random PPO tuning before causal diagnosis

land_economy.conclusion: Land #4 is affordable but not demonstrated as the cause of the low-MCV tail; prior controlled reports are negative.

partially_answered: Market realization, especially milk and strawberry, explains much of the observed high/low gap.
Shared-market pressure and price opportunity both matter.
A simple milk delay to a high-price threshold is harmful in the latest dynamic wrapper counterfactual.
not_cleanly_answered: Exact observable market state causing low milk realization.
Opponent pressure versus price trend versus clearance-step interaction.

decision: No implementation or new game run is justified by this history review. Consume cached traces first for any future diagnostic.
